column6: All three can be done 100% online, including the exams themselves (remote proctoring). Realistic pace: Security+ in 6–8 weeks studying part-time, then each AWS cert in 4–6 weeks since they build on each other.Stage 2 (after you land a role or have more bandwidth):	•	AWS Developer Associate (natural next step after SAA)	•	Terraform Associate (high value if the job involves any IaC/DevOps)	•	CKAD (if you’re leaning toward roles with Kubernetes/container orchestration)	•	Oracle Java SE 21 (only if you’re targeting Java-heavy backend roles)	•	Andrew Ng’s ML Specialization on Coursera (if you want to lean into your ML exposure)Approach tip: Don’t study Security+ and an AWS cert simultaneously — the material doesn’t overlap much and split focus slows you down. Finish Security+, then chain the two AWS certs back to back since Cloud Practitioner content directly feeds into SAA.
